_note: Run via lean_worker with a current Test-Runner or Auditor assignment. visual-install permits a current automation or visual PATH; visual-capture and semantic-inspect require visual. Host owns and attests the live exclusive device lock. These tools create evidence, never a Ledger verdict. Each request_id is a new attempt. Capture requires a visual-install result from the same assignment, fence, device and accepted HAP. Viewport capture requires a stable target. Scroll capture requires frozen source-backed start selectors, a unique scroll_region, and observed scroll_end_match; missing, unstable or incomplete evidence remains partial/Yellow. The existing full runtime adapter also remains supported. A PATH without baseline_ref (image checks only) omits reference_manifest_ref. image-parity (visual assignment) takes args path_id, manifest_ref (the manifest that visual-capture wrote) and round, and measures the PATH's frozen image checks on that capture.
